verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents an official MCP server that lets AI tools/agents interact with it without running shell commands, plus a CLI explicitly for 'terminal or coding agent' use and AI-coding-agent integration (Cursor) for auto-instrumenting tracing — all first-party evidence that AI-native users can drive Langfuse via natural-language-directed agent workflows. However this is exposed through MCP/CLI tooling rather than a native NL command interface, and there is no independent/hands-on evidence validating the experience of controlling Langfuse purely via natural language. Missing for 10: independent/community validation of NL-driven operation, and richer documentation of exactly which actions/commands are exposed via the MCP server or CLI.
